text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Arima Kinen. Who will be the victor—Hishi Amazon, or Narita Brian? Or will it be someone else entirely from the elite lineup?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon gathers her focus with a deep, long breath. Her long-awaited match with Narita Brian is finally beginning!
